title: Last to arrive, first to leave: Slovakia’s Fico is Europe’s reluctant summiteer
lede: A self-declared outcast at EU summits, Slovakia's Robert Fico makes little effort to make friends. Several diplomatic sources said the Slovak prime minister prefers to avoid other EU leaders at summits.

title: Dutch dismiss any deadline on budget deal as EU leaders remain divided on size and new resources of revenue
lede: Deep divisions on the next EU long-term budget remain entrenched with Dutch prime minister Rob Jetten dismissing any talk of an end of December deadline to finalise negotiations. 'I want a good deal, so for me, there's no deadline,' Jetten told reporters as the EU summit began on Thursday.
